guitar.notes: Tony Iommi's Gibson SG (and later custom Jaydee SG-shaped guitar) is iconic and extremely well documented.

tone.target: thick dark fuzz-crunch riff tone with biting upper mids
tone.profile: thick dark fuzz-crunch riff tone with biting upper mids
tone.summary: A classic heavy riff tone built around a Fuzz/Distortion stack into a UK 45 or UK 50 style amp, emphasizing low-mid weight and upper-mid bite for that Sabbath darkness.

rig.name: Black Sabbath - Children Of The Grave - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and excessive noise inherent in heavy fuzz tones.
Provide the foundational thick, dark fuzz saturation required for Sabbath's sound.

alternatives.reason: Good alternative if Fuzz is too aggressive.

blocks.purpose: Add a secondary layer of grit and mid-range punch to complement the fuzz without sounding modern or scooped.
blocks.gap: The OD 9 is used here as a tonal shaping boost rather than primary drive, helping define the upper mids.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic British tube amp sound, providing necessary headroom and vintage grit.
Provide the required closed-back British cabinet sound and tonal coloration.
Sculpt the tone by boosting upper mids for bite and slightly cutting lows to maintain clarity in thick fuzz.
Optional subtle thickening for sustained notes (kept off by default).
blocks.gap: Not strictly necessary, but useful for adding dimension if the riffing becomes too dry.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle rhythmic depth and space without washing out the aggressive riff tone.
blocks.gap: A very minimal delay is used to add dimension, avoiding excessive echo that would muddy the fuzz.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the default IR for a more vintage, closed-back British speaker simulation.

proposals.recommendedAsset: British 4x12 Closed Back IR (e.g., Celestion Greenback/V30 style)
proposals.reason: Enhance vintage grit and closed-back character missing from the default IR.
